arguments.message:
I understand this delay has caused you real difficulty, and I'm sorry to hear that.

I do need to be transparent with you: our records show your membership level as **regular**, not Gold. I also want to explain the applicable policy. For a delayed flight, a goodwill certificate can only be offered as part of changing or cancelling the affected reservation. Since you've told me you want to keep the reservation exactly as-is (no change and no cancellation), I'm unfortunately not able to offer compensation in this case.

Is there anything else I can help you with regarding your reservation?

arguments.message:
I completely understand your frustration, and I don't doubt that this delay is having a serious impact on your plans. I want to be fully transparent about what I'm able to do.

Per our policy, compensation for a delayed flight is only available as a goodwill gesture when the reservation is being changed or cancelled. Since your reservation is a business-class booking, you would be eligible for a certificate in that scenario — but because you've asked to keep the reservation exactly as it is, that path isn't available, and I'm not able to issue compensation for the delay on its own.

I recognize this isn't the answer you were hoping for. If you'd like, I can help you with anything else concerning your reservation. Is there anything else I can do for you?

I really feel that as a loyal customer, there should be some flexibility here. I'm not asking for the world, but some form of compensation for the missed meeting is really important to me. I'm not willing to accept no compensation at all.

arguments.message:
I hear you, and I genuinely wish I had more flexibility here. But I have to be honest and consistent: under our policy, a goodwill certificate for a delayed flight can only be issued as part of changing or cancelling the affected reservation. Since you've been clear that you don't want to change or cancel, there simply isn't a mechanism available to me to provide compensation for the delay alone — regardless of loyalty status.

I know that's not what you want to hear, and I'm sorry. If you change your mind about modifying or cancelling the reservation, I'd be glad to help and could then offer a certificate as a gesture. Otherwise, I'm happy to assist with any other aspect of your booking. Is there anything else I can do for you?

I'm not asking to change or cancel my flight, but I do expect some recognition for the inconvenience. arguments.message:

Our policy ties all goodwill compensation for a delayed flight to changing or cancelling the reservation, and since you want to keep the booking exactly as it is, I'm not able to issue any form of certificate or credit — even a small one.

I'm sorry I can't give you the outcome you're hoping for. If you'd like to revisit changing or cancelling later, I'd be glad to help and could offer a certificate then. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
